text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa crosses the finish line!
The path to "conquering the world" is wide open—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—An undisputed masterclass of a race!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Racking up victory after victory since the Arima Kinen, one could truly say you're in your prime—could you please share your enthusiasm for Dubai with us once more?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a race that no
Japanese Umamusume has ever won.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The joy of sprinting across that stage alongside
my senior in racing, Buena Vista-san—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Holding that close to my heart, I want to give it my all
and run a truly wonderful race."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
It's true that no one has ever won before—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—B-Breaking news!
It has just been announced that Transcend
will also be competing in Dubai!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...!
So that's what it was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems the possibility that crossed my mind before the race was spot on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend is currently in top form, riding a two-race GⅠ winning streak.
It wouldn't be surprising if she received an invitation to Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
With Transcend-san, one of the strongest in dirt,
entering the race, this is going to be really interesting!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Our formidable rivals have increased, but even more than that—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run alongside all of you
and strive wholeheartedly for victory...
truly brings joy to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Furthermore, after that, an announcement was made that Rulership would also be taking on Dubai around the same time, albeit in a different GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racing world was buzzing with excitement over
the overseas expedition of these four talented Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And so, here's to the continued growth
and success of all us Japanese Umamusume~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Cheers♪
Cheers!
Cheers.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for staying quiet, okay?
Bet you were surprised, right!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so!
Is this your first time going abroad too, Tran-san?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yup! So just going there and back might completely exhaust you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I do feel a bit nervous, but... I'm looking forward to it.
I wonder what kind of view awaits us...♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha. —Well, races are an information war in the end.
Teamwork is the key, so let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if everyone joins hands—
the results will surely follow.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you are both comrades and rivals.
Especially those of you running in the same race.
Never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Of course.
Let us run and fight together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes of Japan on their shoulders, the four of them
enjoyed their small, lively banquet for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next domestic race will be the Japan Cup.
Before that, however, I want to challenge the world and weave a victory.
